effect_text: The Adventurers warband has no fixed leader. The adventurers argue and squabble all the time with each other about all kinds of minor things like food and gold, let alone that they can decide on their leader. When creating a warband mark each Hero (except the Imperial Captain) on the roster sheet with a number between 1 and 5. As the Imperial Captain can never become the Leader there is always the chance that the warband will not have a leader for the next battle. Roll a D6 before each battle. Dwarf: if the Dwarf is the Leader of the warband then the Elf is so insulted by this that he won't stay within 6\" of the Dwarf at any time and therefore cannot benefit from his Leadership. Elf: if the Elf is the Leader then the Dwarf is so insulted that he won't stay within 6\" of the Elf and cannot benefit from his Leadership. Wizard: if the Wizard is the Leader then the Barbarian becomes so confused by the difficult commands of the Wizard that he won't stay within 6\" of the Wizard and cannot benefit from his Leadership. Barbarian: if the Barbarian is the Leader then the Wizard becomes so annoyed and irritated by his stupid commands that he won't stay within 6\" of the Barbarian and cannot benefit from his Leadership (see also the Barbarian's \"Dim-witted\" rule). Imperial Noble: as the Imperial Noble is a natural born leader nobody suffers from any negative effects towards any other adventurer in the warband.
